title: Shared errands
description: A small list you can actually keep: add items, tick them done, archive instead of delete. Saved in this browser, so it survives a reload.

sections.heading: Why this page
sections.body: This is daya's first step toward generating code for an existing app: the core of a todo list (add, done, archive, restore) from one recipe section. No account, no server; the list lives in your browser.
